mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id AS "taskId", t.project_id AS "projectId", p.subject, t.title, t.content, t.task_level AS "taskLevel", TO_CHAR(t.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(t.end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endAt", t.status, t.progress FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_member_id = t.project_member_id AND pm.project_id = t.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY t."END" ASC, t.task_id ASC
